payload.prompt: Do exactly these steps, nothing else: (1) In ONE single message, issue THREE Bash tool calls in parallel: 'sleep 3; echo x > x.txt', 'sleep 3; echo y > y.txt', and 'ls'. (2) Use the Agent tool with subagent_type general-purpose, run_in_background true, prompt 'Run the bash command: sleep 4; echo bg > bg.txt . Then stop.' (3) Immediately after launching it, without waiting, use Write to create main.txt with content M. Then wait for the background agent to finish before replying done.
